description: This file contains test cases for the LangGraph provider integration in a Python project. It includes tests for both streaming and non-streaming completion calls, URL configuration, request transformation, and provider detection, using pytest and asyncio.

methods.name: test_langgraph_acompletion_non_streaming()
methods.description: Tests the non-streaming completion call to the LangGraph server asynchronously, asserting the presence and content of the response.

methods.name: test_langgraph_acompletion_streaming()
methods.description: Tests the streaming completion call to the LangGraph server asynchronously, accumulating chunks and verifying receipt.

methods.name: test_langgraph_config_get_complete_url()
methods.description: Verifies that the URL generation logic correctly produces endpoints for streaming and non-streaming modes.

methods.name: test_langgraph_config_transform_request()
methods.description: Checks the request transformation method correctly formats messages and parameters based on streaming options.

methods.name: test_langgraph_provider_detection()
methods.description: Ensures that the provider detection logic correctly identifies 'langgraph' as the provider based on model name.
